info.title: Database Studio Web API
info.description: Tenant-scoped resource API. HTTP mutators require X-CSRF-Token and same Origin. WebSocket studio.v1: hello{version:1,csrf}, watch{execution_id}, page{request_id,execution_id,result_id,offset,limit}, ack{sequence}, heartbeat; one outstanding notification/page, 30s ACK timeout. Pages max256 rows/2MiB. Cookie/session validity and resource authorization checked throughout. No SQL replay. HTTP session/execution resources require X-Studio-Tab, a random32-byte base64url token retained only in browser-tab memory. WebSocket hello includes tab_token; user/login/tab ownership is rechecked. Lost execution admission may be recovered through GET executions?idempotency_key without SQL replay.
